Capt. Girish Munjal, Head of Content, MarinePALS, explains the significance of the joint Tokyo MOU-Paris MoU CIC on cargo securing, highlighting the importance of understanding the requirements, applying them correctly, and ensuring cargo is safely loaded, stowed and secured.
